examples.chinese: 我八點十分去學校。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn shí fēn qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: I go to school at 8:10.

examples.chinese: A：現在幾點？ B：現在十點二十五分。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? B: Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn.
examples.english: A: What time is it now? B: It’s 10:25.

examples.chinese: 我四點四十分下課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sì diǎn sìshí fēn xiàkè.
examples.english: I get out of class at 4:40.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

items.wordHook: An 八(eight) slices fall all around from one 刀(knife) → each piece is a 分(minute).

examples.chinese: 我想買兩本中文書、一本英文書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, yì běn Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: I want to buy two books in Chinese and a book in English.

examples.chinese: 友美愛看書，我想送她兩本中文書，你呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi ài kànshū, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ne?
examples.english: Youmei loves reading. I would like to give her two books in Chinese as a gift. How about you?

examples.chinese: 我有兩枝鉛筆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.
examples.english: I have two pencils.

examples.chinese: 我們買兩枝，好不好？兩枝五十塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi liǎng zhī, hǎo bù hǎo? Liǎng zhī wǔshí kuài qián.
examples.english: How about we buy two of them? Two for 50NT dollars.

examples.chinese: 我有一位英國老師和兩位日本老師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi Yīngguó lǎoshī hé liǎng wèi Rìběn lǎoshī.
examples.english: I have one British teacher and two Japanese teachers.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.
examples.english: These stuff cost twenty three thousand, five hundred and five dollars in total.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.chinese: 客廳裡面有兩張沙發。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng zhāng shāfā.
examples.english: There are two sofas in the living room.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
examples.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 一共兩百一十五塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi yīshíwǔ kuài qián.
examples.english: It will be 215 dollars in total.

examples.chinese: 一共兩百多塊錢，好便宜！
examples.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi duō kuài qián, hǎo piányi!
examples.english: It is only a little over 200. It is cheap!

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 這兩條我都去穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo wǒ dōu qù chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: I will try both on.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 昨天老師教的日本歷史，你念了嗎？這個字我沒學過，怎麼唸？
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān lǎoshī jiāo de Rìběn lìshǐ, nǐ niàn le ma? Zhège zì wǒ méi xuéguò, zěnme niàn?
examples.english: Have you studied the Japanese history that the teacher taught yesterday? I haven't learned this character; how do you pronounce it?

examples.chinese: 念了一個小時的書以後，你最好休息十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Niàn le yī ge xiǎoshí de shū yǐhòu, nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: After studying for an hour, you had better rest for ten minutes.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 這本中文書，我念到第四十三頁了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn Zhōngwén shū, wǒ niàn dào dì sìshísān yè le.
examples.english: I've read up to page 43 of this Chinese book.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 畢業後要工作還是要繼續念書，我得好好地想想再選擇！
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu yào gōngzuò háishì yào jìxù niànshū, wǒ děi hǎohǎo de xiǎngxiang zài xuǎnzé!
examples.english: After graduation, whether to work or to continue studying, I must think it over carefully before choosing!

examples.chinese: 我的父母覺得出國念書才會有美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fùmǔ juéde chūguó niànshū cái huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: My parents think that only by studying abroad will you have a bright future.

examples.chinese: 王教授推薦我去念那個研究所的翻譯課程。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuījiàn wǒ qù niàn nàge yánjiūsuǒ de fānyì kèchéng.
examples.english: Professor Wang recommended that I go study the translation course at that graduate institute.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 「教師節」這個節日是為了紀念偉大的孔子。
examples.pinyin: 「Jiàoshī Jié」 zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn wěidà de Kǒngzǐ.
examples.english: The holiday "Teachers' Day" is for commemorating the great Confucius.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 章先生念國小時，父親帶著他上山下海、到處旅遊，那是屬於他們的美好記憶。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng niàn guóxiǎo shí, fùqīn dàizhe tā shàngshān xiàhǎi, dàochù lǚyóu, nà shì shǔyú tāmen de měihǎo jìyì.
examples.english: When Mr. Zhang was in elementary school, his father took him up mountains and across seas, traveling everywhere; that is a beautiful memory belonging to them.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
幸福的婚姻不僅需要觀念的溝通，更需要感情的交流。
紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
這個字不好念，我重複了好幾次，同學都說不對，害我好想放棄。
他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
難得出國旅行，一定要多照幾張相片留念。
這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。

items.wordHook: A 今(now) over a 心(heart) means your thoughts stay in the present → 念(think of).

examples.chinese: 他會說很多語言，比如說：英文、法文、德文。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì shuō hěn duō yǔyán, bǐrú shuō: Yīngwén, Fǎwén, Déwén.
examples.english: He can speak many languages, for example: English, French, and German.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 聽到那首歌，讓李小姐哭得很傷心。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào nà shǒu gē, ràng Lǐ xiǎojiě kū de hěn shāngxīn.
examples.english: Hearing that song made Miss Li cry very sadly.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩一看到大狗，就嚇得哭起來了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái yí kàn dào dà gǒu, jiù xià de kū qǐlái le.
examples.english: As soon as that child saw the big dog, he was so scared that he started crying.

examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuì hǎo de yánjiūsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 有的小朋友很討厭打針，一看見護理師拿針筒(medical syringe)的樣子就哭了。
王教授推薦我去念那個研究所的翻譯課程。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuījiàn wǒ qù niàn nàge yánjiūsuǒ de fānyì kèchéng.
examples.english: Professor Wang recommended that I go study the translation course at that graduate institute.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。
如果您對學校課程有任何問題，歡迎至辦公室談談。
她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
因為每天跟台灣人練習說話，莫以凡的中文程度越來越好了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi měitiān gēn Táiwān rén liànxí shuōhuà, Mò Yǐfán de Zhōngwén chéngdù yuèláiyuè hǎo le.
examples.english: Because he practices speaking with Taiwanese people every day, Mo Yifan's Chinese level is getting better and better.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
妳身高一百七十公分，體重六十公斤，還不到減肥的程度。
保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 有好的投資機會就該好好掌握，不要等到事後才開始後悔。
七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
康小姐的工作能力很強，能一面掌握會議的重點，一面把會議內容翻譯成外文。

items.wordHook: Combining 掌(in charge) and 握(grasp): 掌握 means grasp, to master.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
這位著名畫家的作品，目前正在美術館展出。
雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。

items.wordHook: Combining 目(eye) and 前(front): 目前 means right now.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。

items.wordHook: An organization giving 食(food) and useful 物(thing) supplies saved like 銀(silver) in a community 行(walk) bank: 食物銀行 means food bank.

examples.chinese: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 台灣有各式各樣的小吃，其中最吸引我的是蚵仔煎。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, qízhōng zuì xīyǐn wǒ de shì kēzǎijiān.
examples.english: Taiwan has all kinds of snacks, among which the one that attracts me most is oyster omelet.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 夜市裡有各種小吃和飲料。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng xiǎochī hé yǐnliào.
examples.english: In the night market, there are various kinds of snacks and drinks.

examples.chinese: 在歐洲，小麥做的各種食品常被當作餐桌上的主要食物。
地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
他很喜歡買文具，尤其是筆，各國進口的原子筆他都有。
他迷上足球，所以買了各式各樣的足球鞋。
他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
我夢想有一天可以到世界各地旅行。
這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
我對人體各部分的功能很有興趣，不過我沒想過當醫生。
新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
電腦工程師除了維護電腦，還要處理各種與電腦相關的問題。

items.wordHook: Each 夂(go) takes its own 口(mouth) along → 各(individual).

examples.chinese: 你放餅乾盒的時候輕一點兒，餅乾碎了就不好吃、不好拿了。
剛跑完步最好不要馬上坐下，這樣對心臟不好。
他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
這次申請獎學金，達到標準的學生總共不超過十人。
為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
冰箱裡的牛奶早就過期了，你還不扔掉嗎？
我剛拖了地，地上還是溼的，你最好繞過去比較安全。

items.wordHook: Stepping 下(below) into or toward 去(go): 下去 means continuously.
地(earth/place) + 址(location) → the place where you are, your address.
To 帶(belt) a 來(arrive): 帶來 means bring.
a 王(jade) stands out for all to 見(see) → it will 現(appear).
